google_ai_service: Google Gemini 1.5 Pro (via Google AI Studio / Vertex AI Gemini API)
task: Multimodal Maritime Risk Assessment & Explainable Tactical Route Re-planning

request_payload.system_instruction: You are POLARIS-AI, an expert maritime decision support copilot complying strictly with IMO Polar Code (POLARIS - Polar Operational Limit Assessment Risk Indexing System). You adhere to the operational axiom: 'AI recommends; the captain decides.' Evaluate ice regimes, calculate RIO scores, detect hazard trajectory intersections, and generate crystal-clear, transparent explainability logs for the shipmaster.
request_payload.user_prompt: Evaluate waypoint WP-02 (-70.05, 74.20) with newly detected drifting tabular iceberg (drift speed 1.2 kn, NE bearing) and first-year ice concentration 3/10. Compare Route A (baseline) against candidate Route B. Output operational status, RIO score, hazard clearance, and concise rationale for navigational command.

response_payload.explainable_ai_brief: Predicted iceberg trajectory and its associated 2.1 km uncertainty corridor now approach Route A within the projected 12-hour arrival window. Remaining on Route A reduces safety clearance to a dangerous 2.6 km under 3/10 ice cover. Recommending Route B expands hazard clearance to 11.0 km while maintaining IMO CII environmental compliance (+3.2% fuel, +1.8 h ETA). Final decision rests with the Master.
